15272523006118.title: Cream/Pink Padded Bra For Women LB5103
15272523006118.description:
Designed for maximum support and a flawless silhouette, our Wired Padded Bra delivers structure, smooth coverage, and all-day comfort. Featuring seamless contour cups, gentle underwires, and wide back bands, these versatile t-shirt bras provide a rounded shape that lies completely flat under your favorite tops and dresses.

Key Features

  • Supportive Underwire Lift: Ergonomic underwires gently lift and define for a naturally rounded, structured profile.

  • Seamless Molded Cups: Smooth, padded cups eliminate lines, making them invisible under tight tops, t-shirts, and light fabrics.

  • Wide Smoothing Wings: High-side coverage panels help smooth underarm and back bulges for a streamlined finish.

  • Pressure-Relieving Straps: Fully adjustable, wide shoulder straps help distribute weight evenly to prevent digging.

  • All-Day Comfort: Crafted with a soft interior lining that feels gentle against the skin.
